list: the official 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze
sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades from the verified draft (Exophase descriptions; names and grades corroborated by PC Gamer, PowerPyx, GTABase and OutputLag). Guides are original wording citing the named guide. Full source links: see SOURCES.md at the repo root.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the finish line, not a task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup — and this unlocks by itself. Nothing here needs online play or DLC. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is the first story trophy, so it cannot be missed — just follow the opening objectives. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. There is no mission replay, so play each mission carefully, but the chapter trophy itself only asks that the chapter ends — no gold medals or extra objectives. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy name is printed censored in every published list, so this guide keeps it exactly as listed and does not guess the full wording. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep playing the story in order; side content can wait, because free-roam stays open after the credits. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. By this point the story is near its end — keep following the main missions and the chapter trophy pops at the chapter's close. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It is a gold trophy because it closes the whole story; there is no difficulty setting, so the same playthrough counts for everyone. After the credits you return to free-roam for cleanup. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission trophies pop on completion, so the only work is reaching the mission and finishing it — retry from the checkpoint if it fails. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, not optional side jobs: play the story until the heist unlocks, then finish it. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, this one is unmissable story progress — it pops when the mission ends. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Work through the story missions in order; the trophy is tied to finishing this one mission, not to any score or optional objective. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Finish the mission objectives and the trophy pops — no stealth rating or extra condition is listed. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named story missions, so it unlocks naturally while playing through the story. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx. Open the checklist at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it only becomes visible after the story, but progress made earlier already counts. The thresholds are lenient (roughly 60% of true completion), and most of it is finished by doing the other trophies. You need 70 of 80 Challenges, so the hardest ones can be skipped. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts build up across all of Leonida, so treat this as a background grind: jump, drift and pull stunts whenever you travel instead of saving them for one session. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them, just sample each one, so work through the list early and tick types off as you find them. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. The ranges are repeatable, so practise one challenge at a time and replay it until the gold score lands; there is no penalty for retrying. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone race location. Learn each course with a practice run first, then race to win — the trophy needs a win everywhere, not just one win. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Vary the race types and locations instead of replaying the same favourite — only distinct wins count toward the 20. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities, so find Cal, enter his challenge and out-fish him; if you lose, challenge him again. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade game through to completion. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the game you find first, finish a full game, and the trophy pops. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger and side-character strands unlock as you explore Leonida, so check back with Andy between story chapters until his last mission appears. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Side strands are optional but never timed: keep visiting Kenton as the story advances and his missions will chain toward the finale. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's missions appear as you roam Leonida — complete each one when it shows up and the strand ends with this trophy. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. This is the silver that ties the side strands together: finish any 8 full stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others) and it pops. Track strands in this checklist. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Like the other character strands, it unlocks through exploration and story progress — return to Randy whenever a new mission marker appears. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Complete his missions in order as they unlock; the trophy pops at the end of his final mission. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged this way by PowerPyx: the first meditation spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and can become unavailable after that chapter. Meditate at every spot across Leonida, and do the Chapter 1 home meditation the first time it is offered — do not leave Chapter 1 without it. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are about tracking specific animals, so follow his strand until the unique animal hunt appears, then complete the hunt as directed in the mission. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida, so collect as you explore and keep sets together — finishing any 3 full sets earns the silver. Check your collection between story chapters. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a long background collectible: photograph or tag spots whenever you pass somewhere new, so the count grows during normal play instead of becoming a 100-stop chore at the end. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the in-game challenge list. Challenges overlap heavily with the other trophies, so most of the 50 arrive while chasing the rest of the list — check the challenge menu and finish the easy ones left over. Only 70 of 80 challenges are needed for 100%, so you can skip the hardest. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the wanted level with your partner nearby, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear — escaping together is the point, so do not split up mid-chase. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past 3 shops close together, rob each in turn, and keep moving — the chain breaks if the wanted level drops between robberies. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count the first time you get in or scan them, so hop into anything unfamiliar as you explore — variety matters, not repeats. For 100% completion you need 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so this trophy is a milestone on that road. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends — pick a crowded encounter rather than a lone enemy. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description is deliberately vague, so the practical read is: leave the airport in a way the game does not schedule, such as taking a plane or vehicle out on your own terms. Exact trigger not yet pinned down in the published guides — check the cited guide for updates. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'). The unlock is tied to dealing with Rhino tanks — expect a combat moment involving them; the exact trigger is not yet pinned down in the published guides, so confirm it in the cited guide before grinding tanks. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards spotting you, take what you came for, and leave before any alarm. If you are seen, leave and try again — detection voids the attempt, not the trophy. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Vault robberies are repeatable heist-style jobs: plan the escape route before you go in, and count each clean escape toward the 5. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one, grab the take and break away before the wanted level pins you down. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, walk and fly into every corner of the map — the trophy tracks map coverage, so fill in the blank areas on your map one region at a time. Exploring also feeds the vehicle and animal counts for 100%. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida — keep a note of which gangs you have done so none is left for the end. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as not yet known. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the trigger is likely a specific spot there, but no published guide has pinned it down yet. Do not grind Ocean Beach blindly; check the cited guide for the confirmed spot. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as not yet known. The description suggests smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style, but the exact showroom and trigger are not confirmed in any published guide yet. Check the cited guide before attempting it. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — finish a game there. The alley is a named activity location, so head there, start a game and play it out. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description gives no concrete step ('A partnership with mass appeal'), so no published guide confirms an exact trigger yet. It reads like a story or side moment tied to a partnership — keep playing the story and side strands, and check the cited guide once the method is confirmed. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description gives no concrete step ('Choices made, for better or worse'), so the exact trigger is not confirmed in the published guides. It points to story choices: play the story, make choices when offered, and expect it to pop from a decision moment rather than a grind. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as not yet known. The description ('Second time's the charm') hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has confirmed what. Do not chase guesses; check the cited guide for the confirmed trigger. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as not yet known. The description ('What the hell just happened?') suggests a strange or rare event, but no published guide confirms the trigger yet. Keep it in mind during exploration and check the cited guide for updates. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as not yet known. The description ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') points to knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact setup is not confirmed. Check the cited guide before grinding drive-bys. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, so keep robbing and laundering through contacts as you play — the total is cumulative and grows alongside the robbery trophies. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. This is cumulative spending, so it finishes naturally if you buy weapons, clothes, food and gear as you go — do not save it for a last-minute shopping spree. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages appear for sale as you explore; buy each one when you can afford it and keep the money flowing — the trophy pops on the last purchase. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, register them through the app, and repeat until 10 are registered — any 10 vehicles count, so use the ones you find while exploring. Source: GTABase GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
